calibration_anchor.note: Drew ground truth 2026-07-25: 36% of total weekly usage, 30% of fable allowance, against internal-$ ledger sums since the 2026-07-24T00:00Z weekly reset. Limits are DERIVED from this anchor (per-axis): weekly = internal_total/drew_total_pct; fable_allowance = internal_fable/drew_fable_pct. Re-anchor whenever Drew reports fresh percentages.

_semantics: The governor (mr-situation) reads the plan's real utilisation from mr-rate-limit-telemetry.jsonl and grades it with soft_pause_frac / hard_stop_frac; the dollar figures here decide only for an axis with no reading in force (bundle budget.source = calibration), and scale effective_usd for the per-launch check. On the calibration: soft/hard fracs apply to weekly_limit_usd; fable_ok = fable_spend < fable_guard_frac * fable_allowance_usd (the allowance is its own axis, not a fraction of weekly).
_telemetry_note: telemetry_fresh_s: how long a reading is acted on as read (three hourly ticks; a decision session can hold the tick lock for 90 minutes). telemetry_window_models: plan windows that cover one model although their name does not carry it; seven_day_overage_included is reported only to Fable sessions and is the window the CLI's 'You've reached your Fable limit' rejection names (fixtures/run-cost/rate-limit-rejected.stream). A window whose name carries a model covers that model; any other covers every model.
